signals.bank_theme: PrivatBank — ATM fleet renewal (800-unit 2026 lot)

Piraeus H1-2026 results 29/07/2026; CMD 2026-2030 carries ~€200m AI spend; Piraeus also named an ECB digital-euro pilot PSP (14/07/2026). Full Act XVIII per-bank allocation via decree 19/2025: OTP 428, MBH 195/316(named variants), K&H 117, Erste 104… (1,039 net-new); Phase-1 complete, **Phase-2 (500–1,000 pop) due 31/12/2026** (A1, A2). signals.date: 01/08/2026 — MBH ≥98% ATM-availability SLA begins · 01/07/2026 certified-validator recirculation rule · Phase-2 deadline 31/12/2026
signals.implies: Certified recyclers/validators + hard uptime SLAs + net-new rural fleet = recyclers, validation HW, telemetry/monitoring, managed/outsourced operation. Strongest hardware+managed-services signal in the footprint; pursue the 9 banks via NCR Atleos channel.
signals.follow_up: Approach OTP/MBH/K&H/Erste on certified-validator retrofit + ≥98% uptime managed-service economics; map which banks run NCR vs Diebold; obtain the MNB validator device list.

signals.bank_theme: Regulatory compliance wave — DORA, AML, PSR, CRA/NIS2, instant
signals.signal: **PSR Article 59 fraud-liability now specified (A3 24/07)**: PSPs must FULLY refund consumers for impersonation ('spoofing') fraud within **10 business days** of notification + police report, with the **burden of proof shifted to the PSP** — a direct pull for fraud-detection/dispute automation (PSR still 'Close to adoption', no OJ; applies ~2028). Mandatory Verification-of-Payee is **already live for euro-area PSPs since 09/10/2025** (non-euro by 09/07/2027) (A3). **CRA**: incident-reporting 11/09/2026, CE-marking 11/12/2027 — ATMs/POS/kiosks/HSMs in scope (A3). **NIS2** transposed (A3). **AMLA**: final ITS on supervisory cooperation published 21/07/2026; CDD RTS (Art 28(1)) due 10/07/2026; provisional ~40-entity list end-Sep-2026; direct supervision 2028 (A3, A8). IPR receive 09/01/2027.
signals.date: 21/07/2026 — AMLA final ITS published · PSR Art 59 fraud-liability specified · CRA incident-reporting 11/09/2026 · IPR 09/01/2027
signals.implies: H2-2026 is the buying window for KYC/onboarding, transaction-monitoring, resilience AND CRA-conformity tooling — core Printec compliance territory. DORA-ready + CRA-conformant managed-services contracts become a sellable advantage.
signals.follow_up: Classify each Printec SKU under CRA; map AMLA thresholds to reference customers (Alpha, Eurobank); package pooled-TLPT + incident-reporting-as-a-service; watch PSR OJ for the VoP clock.

deadlines.forces: Banks must update VoP/matching engines to v1.1 -> name-matching/anti-fraud tooling and payment-hub integration.

deadlines.title: SWIFT CBPR+: unstructured postal addresses removed (Town+Country mandatory)
deadlines.forces: Every footprint bank with cross-border SWIFT traffic must remediate counterparty master-data to structured addresses or payments are NAKed; MT101->pain.001; Case Management Phase 1. Data-quality + message-transformation project.

deadlines.title: EUDI Wallet availability deadline (>=1 wallet per EU member state)
deadlines.forces: Member states must make a wallet available; banks become relying parties/verifiers for wallet-based remote eKYC and SCA. <1/3 of states ready as of Apr-2026 (RO/BG/HR lagging).

deadlines.title: Hungary: Act XVIII Phase 2 'ATM in every settlement >500 people' deadline
deadlines.forces: ~631 net-new mandated rural ATMs (Phase 1's ~1,039 done) into low-traffic sites -> low-cost deployment, recyclers, remote monitoring, outsourced operation. Procurement is private — pursue the 9 obligated banks directly.

deadlines.title: Albania: POS acceptance mandate for all remaining businesses
deadlines.forces: 2026 fiscal package mandates a POS terminal for all taxpayers (accommodation/transport/public institutions were due 30/05/2026) with cash limits cut -> large POS/TMS/acquiring rollout; Mastercard ~4,750 free terminals accelerate volume.

deadlines.title: Bulgaria: Instant Payments Regulation compliance (VoP + equal-charges)
deadlines.forces: BG (euro since 01/01/2026) must implement IPR provisions one year after adoption. Rails already on TIPS via BORICA, so the residual work is Verification of Payee + equal-charges + instant-fraud screening -> budgets commit H2-2026.

deadlines.title: Instant Payments: RECEIVE obligation + equal charges (CZ, HU, RO)
deadlines.forces: Non-euro EU members must be able to RECEIVE instant euro credit transfers -> payments-hub + ISO 20022 + fraud screening spend committing H2-2026.

deadlines.title: NCR Atleos / Brink's merger expected close (~Q1 2027)
deadlines.forces: Printec's key partner becomes part of a CIT conglomerate selling hardware+logistics+managed-services end-to-end. Strategic scenario planning required (continuity / direct competition / rival-OEM courtship). UK CMA review pending.

deadlines.title: Instant Payments: SEND obligation + VoP (CZ, HU, RO, from EUR accounts)
deadlines.forces: Must be able to SEND instant euro credit transfers from EUR accounts + provide Verification of Payee -> completes the instant-rails + name-matching build-out.

deadlines.title: EU AMLR applies (single AML rulebook; EUR 10k cash cap; CASPs in scope)
deadlines.forces: Harmonised CDD/EDD/UBO across all footprint markets; onboarding/monitoring stacks must be compliant; wallet/eID remote-KYC formally accepted; cash thresholds touch recycler reporting workflows.

deadlines.title: AMLA direct supervision begins + SSM TLPT first 3-yr cycle deadline (17/01/2028)
deadlines.forces: ~40 cross-border groups (Erste/RBI/OTP candidates) under direct AMLA supervision; TLPT threat-led testing drives remediation spend on telemetry, monitoring, HSM/PCI.

deadlines.title: Digital euro: potential first issuance (target, contingent on 2026 legislation)
deadlines.forces: 12-month PSP pilot H2 2027-2028; potential issuance 2029. Distribution via banks/PSPs -> ATM/POS acceptance-device + DESP back-end certification, wallet/onboarding, HSM/key management. Low-confidence, long-fuse.

deadlines.title: European Accessibility Act: service-provider transition ENDS
deadlines.forces: Pre-2025 ATMs/terminals only to end of economic life (max 20 yrs from commissioning); every new install since 28/06/2025 must be born-accessible. ESAmeA complaint (GR, 18/02/2026) raising near-term pressure. Replace-vs-retrofit cycle 2027-2030.
